question: On 16 February 2021, Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala was appointed as the seventh Director-General of the WTO. Which country does she belong to?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nigeria.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• On 16 February 2021, **Ngozi Okonjo Iweala** was appointed as the **first Woman Director-General **of** World Trade Organisation **(WTO).
 
• She belongs to **Nigeria.**
 
• Okonjo-Iweala assumed office on 1 March 2021, and became both** the first woman and the first African to hold this position.**
 
• Okonjo-Iweala, the **former finance minister of Nigeria,** will succeed **Roberto Azevedo**, who stepped down in August 2020.
 
• She is the** seventh Director-General of the WTO.** Her term of office will expire on 31 August 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The World Trade Organisation is an international organization set up in** 1995** by replacing the** General Agreement on Trade and Tariffs (GATT)** under the **Marrakesh Agreement.**
 
• The World Trade Organization (WTO) is the only global international organization dealing with the rules of trade between nations.
 
• The WTO has 164 members and 25 observer governments.
 
• Headquarters - Geneva, Switzerland.
